component.name: Hazelux
component.summary: Native Linux desktop file automation daemon and configuration utility

description.p: Hazelux continuously evaluates filesystem events against user-defined declarative rules to automate routine file organization tasks such as sorting, renaming, copying, and cleaning.

ul.li: Fast asynchronous inotify file monitoring with Three-Stat Quiescence Protocol
Declarative rules engine with rich conditions (name, extension, size, modified date, created date, EXIF date)
Crash-resilient SQLite WAL journal tracking and instant one-click Undo
Non-destructive file relocation with rename counter collision resolution
FreeDesktop Trash integration with metadata restoration
Native GTK4 and Libadwaita user interface designed for Zorin OS and GNOME

description.p: New credits About screen with publisher branding, and a real application icon in the system tray with close-to-tray behavior.
Documentation and expansion roadmap release detailing Rehearsal Mode, rule bundles, cron scheduling, and structured activity ledger architecture.
